**Finding: missing (critical)** — no indemnification clause exists anywhere in the Agreement.

- Searches for "indemn", "hold harmless", "defend" and "infring" turned up only incidental references that presuppose an indemnity: § 19.4 ("indemnified claims"), § 21.3 (Excluded Claims include "its indemnification obligations"), § 29.2 (indemnity notices) and § 30.5 ("an indemnified party"... "vested indemnity rights").
- § 9.3 expressly cross-refers to "the remedies required by Section 20.5", but there is no Section 20 in the document — the outline runs from § 19 (Warranties) straight to § 21 (Limitation of Liability). This confirms the planner's hint rather than pointing to text outside the outline.
- With no Vendor IP indemnity at all, this sits in walk-away territory, not merely below the fallback.

Redline (validated, ok:true): a new **Section 20 – Indemnification** inserted after § 19.5, at the preferred position — Vendor defence/indemnity for third-party IP infringement, breach of Applicable Law, Vendor-caused Customer Data incidents, and gross negligence/wilful misconduct; customary exclusions (Customer modification, combination, Customer specifications); notice/control/cooperation procedure with a settlement-consent protection; and procure-modify-replace-refund remedies numbered 20.5 so the existing § 9.3 cross-reference resolves. Our own indemnity is kept narrow to Customer-provided content and Customer's breach of law.
